person.name: Abraham Sanchez
person.headline: Senior Software Engineer
person.tagline: I build games, XR experiences and the tools behind them — from first prototype to live operations.
person.summary: Senior engineer with 10+ years shipping commercial products across PC, mobile (iOS/Android), WebGL and XR. I've shipped two games on Steam, raised player retention on a high-traffic F2P mobile title, led an XR team whose iOS AR app was nominated for the Unity Awards, and automated pipelines that saved tens of thousands in production costs. I care about clean, modular architecture, measurable performance and code that the next developer can pick up fast.
person.availability: Open to remote senior roles · Willing to relocate

Magic Leap 2 experience showcased at AWE

spotlight.title: The Capture Worlds
spotlight.status: Released on Steam (Early Access) · Mostly Positive reviews
spotlight.description: An open-world monster-capture RPG: travel between worlds, fight and capture monsters in real time, train and evolve them, farm, craft and take on quests. I took it from concept to a commercial Steam release, including publishing, post-launch updates and Steam Workshop modding support.
highlights: Deterministic procedural generation for quests and world content spawning
Real-time AI driven by behavior trees
Custom object pooling and memory allocation to cut runtime overhead
Steam publishing, Workshop support, live updates and AWS S3 storage

experience.summary: Reusable frameworks and XR integration for learning apps.
highlights: Designed reusable Unity frameworks using SOLID, MVC and event-driven systems with data-driven ScriptableObjects.
Built modular XR / AR Foundation integration systems that turned screen-based apps into VR-ready cross-platform builds.
Defined development standards and documentation practices that sped up onboarding.
Optimized core systems for runtime stability, memory and rendering performance.

experience.summary: Features and tooling for WWE Champions, a high-traffic F2P mobile game.
highlights: Shipped a new splash screen for WWE Champions that raised player retention by 5%+.
Reduced crash rates by 5% on Android and iOS using Unity Profiler, Android Studio and BugSnag.
Built internal Unity tools for LiveOps and QA teams.
Integrated asset bundling and data-driven UI rendering for faster content delivery.

experience.summary: Gameplay systems for F2P casino titles on mobile and web.
highlights: Engineered gameplay systems for F2P titles on Android, iOS and Facebook Games.
Established the onboarding process for new developers, reducing ramp-up time.
Expanded in-game reward engines and real-time asynchronous messaging systems.
Integrated monetization hooks and analytics frameworks.

experience.role: Senior Unity Developer · Development Team Lead
experience.summary: Led AR/VR delivery across Quest, Magic Leap, visionOS and WebGL.
highlights: Led Unity development of AR/VR applications for Quest, Magic Leap, visionOS and WebGL.

Built an iOS LiDAR scanning system that captures and renders point-cloud data.

experience.summary: AR, WebGL and VR training apps for enterprise clients.

Developed a Magic Leap 2 AR experience showcased at AWE.
Delivered a WebGL virtual-assistant framework for holographic installations.
Built interactive simulations and immersive VR training environments.

experience.summary: My own open-world RPG, from concept to Steam.

Implemented deterministic procedural generation for quests, world spawning and behavior-tree AI.
Built custom object pooling and low-level memory allocation systems.
Managed Steam publishing, post-launch updates and AWS S3 storage.

experience.summary: Turned a prototype into Landless, a survival game on Steam.
highlights: Transformed a prototype into Landless, an open-world survival game released on Steam; led a team of 4.
Automated the asset pipeline, saving over $50K in production costs.
Contributed design changes that helped drive first-year sales above $100K.
Built behavior-tree AI and procedural open-world spawning.
Built a procedural asset-combination system that scaled 40 assets into 4,800+ unique variations.
Developed an NPC generator that automated 80%+ of NPC creation in the final game.
Created 3D environment assets and character models.
